rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling of 3.11 ha polygon in Bengtsfors; completed felling overlaps only 0.6% of the polygon, so not already felled.
No eligible species within 250 m (3 coarse records kept, 5 dropped for uncertainty; none red-listed).

Three eligible threatened site-bound species recorded 517-534 m away with low coordinate uncertainty (25 m), 2022-2025: Bryoria bicolor (EN), Platismatia norvegica (VU), Phellopilus nigrolimitatus (VU). Each has felling-relevant threats such as lack of continuity forest.
Nine site-bound forest NT species were found within 1000 m, all beyond 250 m (nearest 421 m). Effort is adequate (490 records, 75th percentile, county median 75).

uncertainties: Records are 500 m or more away and do not show these species occupy the polygon.
Near-site effort is thin: 0 records inside, 3 within 250 m (county median within 250 m is 1), and 5 coarse records excluded.
Stand characteristics are not described by any tool.
not_established: Presence or absence of red-listed species inside the polygon.
Whether the nearby habitat extends into the notified stand.
Anything about legality of the felling.
next_action: Have a reviewer check the stand for continuity-forest and old-tree lichen, moss and fungus habitat, using the 517-534 m records as pointers. Do this before the felling start date.
